description: Format, minify and validate HTML. Operations: "format" — Pretty-print HTML.; "minify" — Minify HTML (strip comments and collapse whitespace).; "validate" — Check HTML for unclosed/mismatched tags.. Call with "operation" plus "input" (and "options" where relevant).

input.description: format: The HTML to format. minify: The HTML to minify. validate: The HTML to validate.

operation.description: format — Pretty-print HTML. minify — Minify HTML (strip comments and collapse whitespace). validate — Check HTML for unclosed/mismatched tags.

options.description: Options for the chosen operation (each says which operations use it).

indentSize.description: Indent width in spaces. Used by: format.

preserveInline.description: Keep inline elements on one line. Used by: format.

wrapAttributes.description: Put each attribute on its own line. Used by: format.

name: html
title: HTML Formatter
